name: Rentovation
overview: Whether you’ve been priced out of the market or just want to skip the headaches of home ownership, renting makes sense. But making a rental feel like a home can be tricky. Enter Rentovation, giving forever home vibes without forever-living commitments. Leading the charge is Natalie Chong, an interior designer who’s cracked the code on transforming dull temporary places into gorgeous personal spaces. As a past renter, parent and self-proclaimed ‘nest’ specialist, Natalie knows what a game changer finding home is. Say goodbye to boring white walls, dated flooring and awkward layouts because this new series will reveal high-impact before and afters without big-budget, invasive construction. It's finally time to rentovate!
